items.Sentence: Wastewater treatment unit operations and processes at the Facility consist of influent screening using mechanical bar screens...
Wastewater treatment unit operations and processes at the Facility consist of influent screening using mechanical bar screens, aerated grit chambers...
Wastewater treatment unit operations and processes at the Facility consist of ... primary sedimentation tanks...

Wastewater treatment unit operations and processes at the Facility consist of ... 1.5 million gallons of primary flow equalization basins with air- activated sludge process and an anox ic selector zone...
Wastewater treatment unit operations and processes at the Facility consist of ... secondary clarifiers...
Wastewater treatment unit operations and processes at the Facility consist of ... mono- media (anthracite) filters...
Wastewater treatment unit operations and processes at the Facility consist of ... ultraviolet disinfection.
Solids removed through the screening and grit removal processes are hauled offsite and disposed of in a landfill.

Waste solids removed through the sedimentation/clarification process are returned to the sewer system for transport to the City of San Diego Point Loma Wastewater Treatment Plant, where they are again removed and directed to anaerobic digesters at the Point Loma Wastewater Treatment Plant for stabilization.
After digestion, the solids are dewatered and thickened for reuse as a soil amendment or for disposal.
